scope: Full-target beta least lift recognized through the exact reverse-Bessel companion and every-third regular convergents to e; homogeneous-measure method ceiling; proper-target asymmetry; Item282 baseline separation

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: p_n q_(n-1)-p_(n-1) q_n=2(-1)^(n-1), including n=2 with index 4 and determinant -2.

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: rho_n is exactly min |beta| over beta,J with p_n beta-J q_n=2(-1)^(n-1)q_(n-1); every beta equals r_n+ell q_n.

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: beta=0 is impossible: it would force q_n to divide 2q_(n-1), contrary to coprimality, odd q_n, and q_n>2.

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: With eta_n=(-1)^n(e-p_n/q_n)>0, every fixed-RHS solution satisfies (-1)^(n-1)(beta e-J)=2q_(n-1)/q_n-beta eta_n.

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: Under 0<|beta|<q_(n-1)/2, the relative correction to the moving target is below 1/[4Q_(3n-1)] and 0<(-1)^(n-1)(beta e-J)<1/n.
claims.evidence: report equations (5.5)-(5.11), including the n=2 lower-scale equality

claims.label: PROVED SCOPED METHOD BARRIER
claims.claim: For fixed C,lambda>0, a homogeneous estimate |beta e-J|>=C(1+|beta|)^(-lambda) combined only with the target magnitude yields just 1+rho_n>(Cn)^(1/lambda).
claims.scope_limit: does not apply to arguments retaining the inhomogeneous center, correction sign/width, restricted indices, Ostrowski digits, or new congruences

claims.label: PROVED SCOPED METHOD BARRIER
claims.claim: After reducing J/beta by d=gcd(J,beta), the standard uniform continued-fraction measure for e applies without a primitivity assumption on the fixed-RHS pair and, combined only with the target magnitude, yields rho_n log(2rho_n) >> n.
claims.scope_limit: a polynomial-scale consequence, not a factorial lower bound

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: For every Q>1 dividing q_n, rho_(n,Q) is the centered reduction of r_n modulo Q and is the minimum |beta| solving p_n beta-JQ=2(-1)^(n-1)q_(n-1).

claims.label: PROVED ASYMMETRIC
claims.claim: A full-target upper bound transfers to proper Q, but a full-target lower bound does not; p_n/Q is not the e-Pade convergent p_n/q_n.

claims.label: PROVED
